sources.snippet: Gemini 3.5 Transcribe is a speech-to-text model based on Gemini's audio understanding capabilities. It provides low-latency, accurate transcription with utterance-based language detection, speaker diarization, word-level timestamps, Smart transcription, and custom vocabulary speech biasing.
